remarks: If you’ve been looking for something move in ready, low maintenance, and close to Claremont, this one is worth a look. Located on the upper level of the Quail Creek community, this fully renovated condo feels bright, clean, and comfortable from the moment you walk in. The vaulted ceilings help open up the space, while the private balcony gives you a place to step outside and enjoy the mature trees, greenery, and running streams that make this community feel different from your typical condo complex. Quail Creek offers a pool, spa, tennis courts, clubhouse, community laundry (currently being renovated), and beautifully maintained grounds. You’re also just minutes from Claremont V
